title: SQLite foreign-key enforcement needs an explicit PRAGMA
fix_summary: PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON on every SQLite connection

title: Room numbers are unique per block, not globally
fix_summary: By design: the same number may exist in different blocks
note: Rooms are always shown with their block name.

title: End date before start date accepted
fix_summary: Server-side date validation

title: Past start dates are accepted by the server (back-dating)
fix_summary: Documented behavior; the browser form sets min=today but the server accepts earlier dates (within 2000-2100)
note: Decide whether back-dating is a requirement; align the form and the server.

title: Model allowed duplicate active allocations for a student
fix_summary: has_active_allocation() check in allocate() and in the route

title: No database constraint on one active allocation per student
fix_summary: Partial unique index uq_active_allocation_per_student (SQLite/PostgreSQL). Reclassified from "Mitigated": it is now enforced by the database
note: See DEF-048 for MySQL.

title: Warden approval workflow not implemented
note: Feature outside the implemented scope.

title: CSRF protection missing
fix_summary: CSRFProtect + tokens in every form. The earlier verification was invalid (see DEF-038); it is now verified by tests that run with CSRF enabled

title: "Missing date validation in reallocation"
fix_summary: Not a defect: reallocation does not change dates (the original log itself says it is "not strictly needed")
note: Kept in the register so the original ID is accounted for.

title: A test asserted the wrong behavior for end date < start date
fix_summary: Assertion corrected. (The original log reused this ID for a concurrency item; that item is DEF-016/DEF-025.)

title: Cancellation could decrement occupancy twice
fix_summary: Status check in cancel(); vacate never goes below zero

title: Cancelled allocations could be reallocated
fix_summary: Status check in reallocate()

title: Failed operations left partial state changes
fix_summary: Preconditions checked before changes; new bed taken atomically before the old one is released

title: SQL-injection/XSS tests only checked for HTTP 200
fix_summary: Assertions verify payloads are neutralized and data is intact

title: CSRF test skipped / vacuous
fix_summary: Original "fix" still ran with CSRF disabled. Replaced by genuine CSRF tests (see DEF-038)

title: Bed counters could be corrupted by concurrent requests (lost update)
fix_summary: Reclassified from "Documented". Counters are now changed with one conditional UPDATE and protected by CHECK constraints (see DEF-025)
note: Verified with a stale-object test that reproduces the lost update; not load-tested with truly parallel clients.

title: Student relationship renamed to student_profile
fix_summary: Routes and templates updated

title: Student allocation view used the wrong relationship
fix_summary: View corrected

title: Logout was a GET link (logout-CSRF)
fix_summary: Logout is POST-only and CSRF-protected; sidebar uses a POST form

title: debug=True hard-coded in run.py and __main__.py
fix_summary: Debug only when FLASK_DEBUG=1; server binds 127.0.0.1

title: Hard-coded fallback SECRET_KEY; known demo accounts seeded and displayed by default
fix_summary: Random per-process key unless SECRET_KEY is set; demo data and credential display are opt-in; create-admin CLI added

title: No login throttling
fix_summary: Lockout after 5 failures per (address, e-mail) for 15 minutes
note: See DEF-046 for limits.

title: A live session of a deleted user caused HTTP 500
fix_summary: Stale sessions are cleared and treated as logged out

title: No security headers; third-party CDN assets without SRI; weak cookie settings
fix_summary: CSP with per-request nonce, nosniff, frame-deny, referrer policy, no-store; Bootstrap vendored locally; HttpOnly/SameSite cookies; Secure+HSTS via setting
note: See DEF-049 and DEF-050.

title: Non-atomic bed counters; "retry on IntegrityError" could not prevent overbooking; no CHECK constraints
fix_summary: Conditional UPDATE for allocate/vacate; CHECK constraints on capacity, occupancy and status; retry loop removed

title: Absurd dates accepted (year 9999, 1900)
fix_summary: Dates restricted to 2000-01-01 .. 2100-12-31

title: "Show full rooms" ignored the block filter
fix_summary: Block filter applied to the full-rooms query

title: Validation errors wiped everything the user had entered
fix_summary: Form is re-rendered with the submitted values
evidence_browser: validation error keeps all entered values

title: Deprecated APIs (Query.get, utcnow): 539/927 warnings per run
fix_summary: db.session.get / db.get_or_404; timezone-safe UTC helper; warning filter removed
note: Verified by the warning count parsed from results/pytest_output.txt.

title: Pages overflowed horizontally on a 390px viewport (583-677px wide)
fix_summary: min-width:0 on the flex content column
note: Reproduced before the fix (scrollWidth 623-677px) and verified in headless Chrome after it.

title: Hamburger button overlapped the page title on mobile
fix_summary: Top bar reserves space for the button

title: Two Logout controls on desktop
fix_summary: Single POST logout form in the sidebar; top-bar duplicate removed

title: "My Allocation" shown to admins/wardens and linked to Available Rooms
fix_summary: Shown to students only, linked to their own allocation; students also get Available Rooms

title: Literal "—" text in the End column
fix_summary: Real em dash character instead of an escaped entity
note: Found while capturing screenshots with populated data.

title: Error messages disappeared after 5 seconds
fix_summary: Only success/info messages fade out
evidence_browser: error message persists beyond the 5 s auto-dismiss window

title: Native window.confirm(): unstyled, inconsistent, not capturable as evidence
fix_summary: Accessible Bootstrap confirmation modal

title: Reports contradicted the artifacts (junit showed 88 tests/26 failures vs "100% pass"; wrong counts, coverage and run time)
fix_summary: All numbers are now generated from results/junit.xml and coverage.xml by scripts/build_reports.py
note: The build fails if a cited test is missing or did not pass.

title: The suite contained no genuine CSRF tests (CSRF disabled; assertions accepted 200)
fix_summary: tests/test_csrf.py runs with CSRF enabled; TestCSRFProtection repaired
note: Mutation check: with CSRF disabled, 10 of the 15 test_csrf.py tests fail.

title: Manual tests were reported as executed but never were
fix_summary: Cases rewritten and marked Not Executed; a human must execute them (TESTING_PROCEDURE.md)
note: BLOCKING for the "execute manual tests" requirement of Assessment 8.

title: Tests created 25 active allocations for one student (violates a business rule)
fix_summary: Tests use 25 distinct students

title: UI tests only searched for substrings
fix_summary: Added DOM-parsing behavior tests; weak tests strengthened in place

title: Two divergent copies of the application and tests
fix_summary: One application, one test suite, one dependency file
note: Verified by the builder: exactly one hms_app/ package and one requirements.txt.

title: Unused dependencies declared (Flask-Login, bcrypt, pytest-flask)
fix_summary: Removed from requirements

title: Manual sheet contained unexecutable or wrong cases (swapped columns, GET to POST-only URLs, wrong expected status)
fix_summary: Sheet rewritten; its expected results are checked by a scripted dry run
note: The dry run is automated and is not manual-execution evidence.

title: Reallocation overwrites the allocation row; no movement history
note: Add an allocation-history table if auditability is required.

title: Login throttle is per-process memory (not shared between workers; resets on restart)
note: Use a shared store (e.g. Redis) before running several workers.

title: New DB constraints only apply to newly created databases (no migration tooling)
note: Recreate or migrate any pre-existing hms.db.

title: MySQL has no partial indexes: one-active-allocation rule is application-level only there
note: SQLite (default) and PostgreSQL are covered.

title: CSP allows inline styles (templates use style attributes)
note: Move inline styles to CSS classes, then drop style-src unsafe-inline.

title: Secure cookie flag and HSTS are opt-in (need HTTPS)
fix_summary: Set SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE=1 in any HTTPS deployment

title: Success/error messages were rendered below the whole page layout (below the fold): users did not see feedback without scrolling
fix_summary: Messages render at the top of the page content, inside <main>
evidence_browser: error message is visible in the first screen
note: Found by reviewing screenshots; no earlier test could detect it.

title: No way to add blocks, rooms or students: a normal installation was empty and unusable (data existed only through demo seeding)
fix_summary: Admin-only, CSRF-protected forms with server-side validation: Add block, Add room, Add student; list pages show the buttons to admins only
evidence_browser: admin adds a block;admin adds a room;admin adds a student;new student can log in
note: Introduced when demo seeding was made opt-in (DEF-021) without providing another way to enter data. No edit or delete of blocks, rooms or students exists yet (see DEF-053).

title: Blocks, rooms and students can be added but not edited or deleted through the interface
note: Corrections currently need database access. Out of scope for the Room Allocation module.

title: After client-side validation blocked a form, the submit button stayed disabled on "Processing..." so the user could not correct the input and retry without reloading
fix_summary: "Processing..." is applied only if the submit event was not cancelled; Back-navigation restores the button
evidence_browser: submit button stays usable after a blocked submit
note: Found by reviewing the manual-case reference screenshots (ALLOC-06, ALLOC-10); the previous tests and browser checks never inspected the button after a blocked submit.
